## Talia Automates - Daily Lead Follow-up

Reads active leads from Google Sheets every morning, selects rows whose next_follow_up date is due, sends one personalized Gmail message per lead, then stamps last_sent so the same lead is not emailed twice that day.

Required columns: lead_id, name, email, interest, next_follow_up, status, last_sent, subject, body.

Before activating: connect Google Sheets and Gmail credentials, select the same spreadsheet in both Sheets nodes, replace YOUR_NAME in the code node, test with your own email, and confirm the workflow timezone.
